name: quote
title: Quote
description: A quotation with its attribution, in real <figure>/<blockquote> semantics — a testimonial, a finding quoted from a report, a line from an interview. For the system's own voice use ordinary text; this is for someone else's. Copy: the words are the speaker's, unedited; trimming a quote to fit is how a testimonial stops being one. `by` is a person, `source` is where they said it or what they do — an
